feed.title: Hormuz Oil Tracker — daily estimate history
feed.subtitle: Our own daily model estimates of oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz, each shown with its working range. Not a measurement. Full archive: https://oilthroughhormuz.com/data/history.json and https://oilthroughhormuz.com/data/history.csv.

entry.title: Hormuz oil flow estimate for 2026-10-30: 6.3 million b/d (range 4.9–15.2) — extrapolated past our tested horizon
entry.summary: This is our own model's estimate for 2026-10-30, not a measurement. Working range 4.9 to 15.2 million barrels per day; treat the range as the answer. This estimate is extrapolated past our tested horizon, so its range is wider than our normal back-tested band. Method: GPCI transit-share, anchored on 2Q26.
